// Type: Bug | Deployment: Cloud | Component: XIUM (deviceConnect) | Suggested section: Appium automation
// Release label: 2611.12 (from the deviceConnect build listed in the Jira release comment)

- Fixed XIUM sessions returning errors without W3C error names when the new-session request sends capabilities in `firstMatch` without `alwaysMatch`, as the Selenium 3 and Selenium 4 Java clients do (for example, Appium Java client 7, 10, and 11). These sessions now receive W3C error names and a W3C new-session response, so the client throws the expected exception, such as `NoSuchElementException` when an element is not found, instead of a general `WebDriverException`. The log message `incorrect JSON status mapping for 'unknown error' (500 expected)` no longer appears. Sessions that send `alwaysMatch` or only `desiredCapabilities`, and Basic Appium sessions, are unchanged.
